definitions.explanation: a face-to-face discussion or meeting, often for evaluation, consultation, or formal discussion

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a suru-verb: {面談|めんだん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to have an interview/meeting)
{面談|めんだん} emphasizes a face-to-face discussion and is commonly used in business and educational settings.

TYPES:
- ⟦{個人|こじん}→個人：02758_kojin⟧{面談|めんだん} (individual meeting)
- ⟦{保護者|ほごしゃ}→保護者：11564_hogosha⟧{面談|めんだん} (parent-teacher conference)
- ⟦{就職|しゅうしょく}→就職：03209_shuushoku⟧{面談|めんだん} (job interview - though ⟦{面接|めんせつ}→面接：01100_mensetsu⟧ more common)
- ⟦{進路|しんろ}→進路：14321_shinro⟧{面談|めんだん} (career guidance meeting)
